queryPrivati = f"""
    (SELECT parentDescription as description
        ,parentID as internalistitutionid
        ,sum(async_numero_tot) as TotAsync
        ,sum(async_valore_tot) as ValAsync
        ,'ASYNC' as Tipo
        ,CONCAT('EC-',RIGHT(parentID,5),'-{trimestre}-{anno}') as numFattura
    FROM [ppa].[report_privati]
    WHERE year_quarter = '{year_quarter}'
    and parentID is not null
    GROUP BY parentDescription,parentID

    UNION
    SELECT parentDescription as description
        ,parentID as internalistitutionid
        ,sum(sync_numero_tot) as TotAsync
        ,sum(sync_valore_tot) as ValAsync
        ,'SYNC' as Tipo
        ,CONCAT('EC-',RIGHT(parentID,5),'-{trimestre}-{anno}') as numFattura
    FROM [ppa].[report_privati]
    WHERE year_quarter = '{year_quarter}'
    and parentID is not null
    GROUP BY parentDescription,parentID
    HAVING sum(sync_numero_tot) > 0
    UNION
    SELECT [description]
        ,internalistitutionid
        ,sum(async_numero_tot) as TotAsync
        ,sum(async_valore_tot) as ValAsync
        ,'ASYNC' as Tipo
        ,CONCAT('EC-',RIGHT(internalistitutionid,5),'-{trimestre}-{anno}') as numFattura
    FROM [ppa].[report_privati]
    WHERE year_quarter = '{year_quarter}'
    and parentID is null
    GROUP BY [description],internalistitutionid
    HAVING sum(async_numero_tot) > 0

        ,sum(sync_valore_tot) as ValSync

    FROM [ppa].[report_privati]
